deep_reading.architecture_zh: 使用双塔（two-tower）检索架构：用户塔和 Pin 塔分别编码，因为检索阶段没有显式 user-Pin 交互特征。塔内使用 DCN v2 作为 cross network，并设计了并行结构：DCN v2 cross network 与 3 层 MLP 并行从原始输入学习，避免原先顺序结构中 MLP 只能看到 DCN 处理后的信息所造成的信息瓶颈；cross network 每层引用原始输入构造高阶特征交叉，MLP 学习隐式抽象模式。2023 版采用 multi-head 共享 encoder + engagement head + conversion head，用 distinct sampled softmax loss 联合训练；2025 版改为 unified single-head multi-task 架构，合并两个 head，使 serving 时最终 embedding 直接受益于多任务优化，并加入 advertiser-level loss 作为额外训练目标。serving 时只使用 conversion 的 Pin/query embeddings。
business_implications_zh: 转化候选生成直接提升购物转化量和 impression-to-conversion rate，对广告主 RoAS 有正向影响。
同时提升 CTR 和 30 秒以上 CTR，说明转化优化与用户体验改善并不矛盾。
在 600M+ MAU 的广告场景中，将 engagement-based 检索升级为 conversion-aware 候选生成可以带来可量化的商业价值。
并行 DCN v2 + MLP 架构被多个生产广告 retrieval 模型采用，说明该技术投资可复用于 engagement 目标。

evidence_refs.heading: Model Architecture and Loss function Design

deep_reading.implementation_zh: 训练数据设计：一个模型覆盖所有 shopping surfaces（Homefeed、Related Pins、Search），同时加入 surface-specific features；使用 conversion + engagement（clicks/repins）双正样本，点击按停留时长 t 经重加权函数 w 处理（t_max 为可调上限）以降低噪声；负样本除 in-batch negatives 外，还用无 engagement 的广告曝光作为 harder negatives，反映真实广告分发分布。特征：用户侧包括实时上下文特征（subject Pin 的 visual 与 GraphSAGE embedding）和长期偏好/历史特征（人口属性、聚合历史行为、Transformer 生成的用户历史序列 embedding）；Pin 侧包括 ID 特征、多模态/内容特征和 engagement 表现特征。损失函数：采用 sampled softmax loss，多任务间用不同 loss weight 平衡。
lessons_zh: 用单一模型覆盖所有购物 surface，可以避免稀疏转化 label 被进一步切碎。
将 conversion 作为主信号、engagement 作为辅助/补充信号，可以扩大数据覆盖、提升泛化和广告漏斗留存。
并行 cross/deep 结构比顺序结构更能保留原始输入信息，显著提升检索召回，并可迁移到其他 engagement retrieval 模型。
从 multi-head 演进到 unified multi-task，能让 serving 时的 embedding 直接受益于多任务优化，并在低转化覆盖区域稳定 query embedding。
引入 advertiser-level 监督可以缓解 Pin 级转化 label 的高方差，更贴合转化信号的自然粒度。
limitations_zh: 转化数据本身稀疏、噪声大且有延迟，Pin 级 label 方差高，模型优化仍受这些数据约束。
检索阶段无法使用显式 user-Pin 交互特征，双塔表示可能损失交互级信息。
点击数据用于扩充正样本，但点击噪声需要通过时长重加权来缓解。
博客中的定量结果标注为 Pinterest Internal Data（US 2023-2025），未提供外部验证或完整实验细节。
production_constraints_zh: 站外转化事件稀疏、噪声大、由广告主上报且有延迟，是建模的核心约束。
点击数据更稠密但有噪声，需要用点击时长重加权来减少 false positive clicks。
需要平衡 conversion 与 engagement 两个任务，避免高价值转化信号被更频繁的 engagement 数据稀释。
检索阶段需要低延迟，因此不能使用显式 user-Pin 交互特征，双塔结构限制了可用的特征表达。
转化标签在 Pin 粒度方差高，Pin 级监督难以稳定建模购买意图。
多 surface 场景需要兼顾共性建模和差异学习，不能简单混合所有 surface 数据。
results_zh: 并行 DCN v2 + MLP 结构在 conversion 任务上带来 offline recall@1000 提升 +11%。
从 2023 到 2025 的模型（含 unified multi-task、advertiser-level loss 等）平均 conversion 任务 recall@100 相对 2023 模型提升 +42%。
2023 年引入新 candidate generation 后，shopping conversion volume 提升 2.3%，shopping impression-to-conversion rate 提升 2.7%。
CTR 提升 1.5%，CTR over 30 seconds 提升 2.2%。
2025 年进一步迭代后，US shopping campaigns 的 RoAS 提升 3.1%。
并行 architecture 被所有生产 engagement retrieval models 采用，获得类似 recall 提升以及在线指标收益。
deep_reading.system_context_zh: 这是 Pinterest 广告检索（candidate generation / retrieval）阶段为购物转化（conversion，如下单、加购）构建的候选生成模型。历史上购物广告检索主要依赖 engagement（点击、repin）信号；转化事件发生在站外、由广告主上报，因此稀疏、有噪声且延迟。系统需要面向 Pinterest 600M+ 月活跃用户，在 Homefeed、Related Pins、Search 等多个购物场景生成高购买意图候选，最终提升广告主 RoAS 和用户体验。
tradeoffs_zh: 顺序 DCN v2 + MLP 结构简单高效，但存在信息瓶颈；并行结构增强表达力，需要验证延迟与收益的平衡。
multi-head 架构可同时利用 engagement 与 conversion 数据，但 serving 只用 conversion embedding，最终 embedding 不能直接受益于多任务优化；unified multi-task 架构缓解了这一问题。
engagement 数据丰富但噪声大，conversion 数据高价值但稀疏；通过点击时长重加权和 auxiliary task 来平衡两者。
单一多 surface 模型避免稀疏 label 碎片化，但要靠 surface-specific features 学习不同场景的上下文差异。
advertiser-level loss 的监督粒度更稳定，但这是相对于 Pin 级监督的取舍。

excerpt: Authors: Richard Huang | Machine Learning Engineer II; Yu Liu | Senior Machine Learning Engineer; Ziwei Guo | Senior Machine Learning Engineer; Andy Mao | Staff Machine Learning Engineer; Supeng Ge | Sr. Staff Machine Learning Engineer Introduction At Pinterest, conversion ads are crucial for matching users with products they are likely to purchase, boosting value for both users and advertisers¹. While conversion actions like checkout or add-to-cart are highly valuable, they are also technically challenging to optimize for. Because they occur offsite, conversion events are significantly sparser and noisier than onsite engagement signals. Historically, Pinterest’s shopping ads retrieval relied on engagement-based models. While effective for driving interaction, this system was not designed to optimize for lower-funnel conversions. This gap motivated us to build a dedicated candidate generation model tailored for conversions, aiming to surface higher-intent products and improve advertiser performance. We launched our first shopping conversion model in 2023, achieving meaningful wins across both conversion and engagement, including a higher clickthrough rate (CTR). Further iterations in 2025 unlocked even stronger conversion value and improved Return on Ad Spend (RoAS) for our advertisers. This blog post documents our journey building this conversion candidate generation model, from its technical design and challenges to the key learnings of deploying it to our 600+ million monthly active users at Pinterest. Training Data Design Modeling conversion events is challenging. Unlike frequent, real-time onsite engagements (e.g., clicks), offsite conversions are reported by advertisers, making the data sparse, noisy, and delayed. Despite these difficulties, conversions remain one of the most valuable signals for a purchase intent model, offering a far stronger indication of advertiser value and true user intent than engagement alone. To address the inherent sparsity of conversions, we made several key design decisions: Multi-Surface Model: We train a single model across all shopping surfaces (Homefeed, Related Pins, Search) to avoid fragmenting sparse conversion labels. At the same time, we incorporated surface-specific features to learn contextual differences between these surfaces. Dual Positive Signals: We supplement primary conversion signals with onsite engagement data (clicks, repins). This broadens data coverage, improving model generalization and ad funnel survival rates. To mitigate click data noise and decrease false positive clicks, we apply a log-based re-weighting function w based on the click duration: where t is the non-negative click duration in seconds and tₘₐₓ is a tunable constant used to cap the re-weighting function. Negative Sampling: On top of the existing in-batch negatives, we use ad impressions with no engagement as “harder negatives.” These samples can reflect the real distribution of served ads, exposing the model to a more representative inventory and promoting robust contrastive learning. In summary, our multi-task approach uses engagement prediction as an auxiliary task to stabilize training and boost performance. The crucial challenge is balancing the two tasks, ensuring the high-value conversion signal is not diluted by the more frequent engagement data. Feature Engineering At the core of our model are features that capture critical signals about our users and shopping catalog, grouped into two categories: User-side and Pin-side. User-side features are split into two types. First, context features capture a user’s real-time intent, which is vital for applications like Related Pins and Search. Examples include a subject Pin’s visual and GraphSAGE² embeddings. Second, preference & historical features capture long-term interests for personalization. These include demographics, aggregated historical actions, and sequential data processed by a Transformer to create a user history embedding. Pin-side features
summary_zh: Pinterest构建了面向购物转化的广告候选生成模型：使用多表面统一训练、转化与点击双正样本、曝光负样本和辅助互动任务，结合用户实时上下文、长期偏好特征、Transformer历史序列以及GraphSAGE等Pin侧特征，以提升低漏斗转化效果和广告ROAS。
title: From Clicks to Conversions: Architecting Shopping Conversion Candidate Generation at Pinterest
